REPLACE-CHECK

The check passes in the current (unfixed) state of the repository because macOS `forkpty` does not emit the same DeprecationWarning that Python 3.13 on Linux does. The second command confirms the warning *would* appear on the CI environment described in the issue, but the check command passes regardless. A valid oracle must fail before the fix and pass after; this one passes both times on this machine, so it cannot distinguish "done" from "untouched." The replacement check should either run on a Linux CI image or explicitly grep the warning output to verify it's absent.
